scenarios.name: normal_ventilation
scenarios.description: Reference vector: OAF 0.18 against a 0.25 alarm point (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 18.4 °C) — design minimum plus normal spread

scenarios.name: excess_outdoor_air
scenarios.description: Reference vector: OAF 0.40 (oat 2 °C, rat 22 °C, mat 14.0 °C) — 0.25 above design; alarms after alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: margin_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAF 0.25 exactly (mat 17.0 °C), so the margin equals oaf_threshold — the strict `>` means no fault

scenarios.name: margin_just_over_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAF 0.26 (mat 16.8 °C) clears the strict comparison and alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: small_delta_not_evaluable
scenarios.description: NO_EVAL: |oat − rat| = 2 °C (oat 20 °C, rat 22 °C) with mat 14 °C, so the raw fraction reads 4.0 — an ungated rule would alarm; yTempDeltaOk stays false and holds yFault down

scenarios.name: delta_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: |oat − rat| = 6.0 °C exactly (oat 16 °C, rat 22 °C) with OAF 0.50 — the strict `>` leaves the rule not evaluable

scenarios.name: transient_excess_clears_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: OAF jumps to 0.40 at t=600 and falls back to 0.18 at t=1800 — 1200 s of excess, short of alarm_delay, so no alarm

scenarios.name: summer_excess_oat_above_rat
scenarios.description: Sign case: outdoor air warmer than return (oat 35 °C, rat 24 °C, mat 28.4 °C) — the fraction still reads 0.40 and the rule alarms after alarm_delay
